claim.statement: More than 50% of Sivers' FY2025 total revenue (SEK 183.4M out of 306.6M) came from three Wireless-segment customers; the Photonics segment (SEK 93.4M, +17% YoY) has no disclosed customer exceeding 10% of group revenue, implying Photonics customer concentration is lower.

claim.statement: Sivers FY2025 group gross margin was -0.7% (gross loss SEK 2.1M on revenue SEK 306.6M), a deterioration from +1.9% in FY2024, driven by raw material costs more than doubling (+116%) as the company scales production ahead of Photonics ramp.
